faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Pathanamthitta District Court Computer Assistant/LD Typist recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Pathanamthitta District Court Computer Assistant/LD Typist recruitment is 09 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Computer Assistant/LD Typist post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Computer Assistant/LD Typist post will receive a salary of Rs. 23360 Per Month.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all posts in this recruitment is 62 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Computer Assistant/LD Typist post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Computer Assistant/LD Typist post primarily involves Document Verification.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: Applications need to be submitted offline. You need to download the application form, fill it, and send it to the address mentioned in the official notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Computer Assistant/LD Typist.

faq.answer: The job type for this position is contractual.

faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the Pathanamthitta District Court.
